chi_tiet.tieu_de: Why Some Apex Predators Don't Hunt Humans
chi_tiet.mo_ta:
Some of the most powerful apex predators on earth are fully capable of hunting humans, yet they don’t hunt us. In this video, we explore four iconic predators from the deepest oceans to the tallest mountains and learn why these apex predators don’t see humans as prey. With the help of behavior, biology, and decades of research, we reveal how instinct, intelligence, culture, and habitat decide what these animals choose to hunt.

Hope you enjoyed it! If you did I would highly appreciate a like on the video.
